name: auto-handoff
description: Writes a cold-start handoff to handoff/ before the context fills up or compacts, and offers to resume from it in the next session.

threshold.title: Context threshold (%)
threshold.description: Write a handoff automatically once the context window is this full. /autohandoff threshold <n> overrides it.

enabled.title: Automatic handoffs
enabled.description: Write handoffs automatically at the threshold and before compaction. /autohandoff on|off overrides it.
